subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Good Citizen" answering the
stimulus: following questions. You should write it in 200 words. 10 (a) What do you mean by ‘A good citizen’? (b) What are the qualities needed to be a good citizen? (c) How can a person become a good citizen? (d) What role does a good citizen play to build a developed country? Board & Test Questions : First Paper (e) What are our duties and responsibilities to become a good citizen?
